descriptions.zh:
有什么东西在我们体内觉醒了。我们才刚刚开始了解其中暗指。

释放所有[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]们蕴含的灵能，我们就可以超越肉体存在的局限。
descriptions.en:
Something has awoken inside of us. We are only beginning to understand the implications.

By unlocking the psionic abilities latent in all [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we can transcend the limitations of our physical existence.

descriptions.zh:
通过召集囚禁的[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]并迫使其参加科学实验，我们就能显著提高科技进展的速度。

§Y[Owner.GetTestSubjectPlural]的总数量§!：§G[Owner.GetNbTestSubjects]§!
建造§H实验研究所§!以获取§H实验对象§!。
descriptions.en:
By gathering imprisoned [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] and subjecting them to scientific experiments, we can significantly increase the pace of our technological advancement.

§YTotal number of [Owner.GetTestSubjectPlural]§!: §G[Owner.GetNbTestSubjects]§!
Build §HExperimentation Chambers§! to gain §HTest Subjects§!.

sections.zh: 实验对象产生的局势进展

descriptions.zh:
我们已经与§R轮回之终末§!签订了契约，获得了无上力量。我们的[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]们认为，这笔交易的代价可以通过集体灵能出神来推迟——但只能推迟这么长时间。

超主的意志将会化为强力的灵能光环降临。如果我们想实现终末，就要把散播这个光环作为我们的终极目标。随着我们愈发人多势众，心智之力也在增长，光环的力量和范围也会随之扩大。

有待征服的恒星系：§Y[Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]§!
descriptions.en:
We have forged a Covenant with the §REnd of the Cycle§!, granting us overwhelming power. Our [Owner.GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the cost of our bargain can be deferred by collective psionic trance - but only for so long.

The will of our patron is manifested in an intense Psionic Aura. If we intend to realize the End, the spread of this Aura must be our ultimate goal. As our numbers grow, and the strength of our minds increases, so too will the Aura's power and reach.

Systems remaining to be conquered: §Y[Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]§!

descriptions.zh:
我们与§R轮回之终末§!签订契约，赐予我们无上伟力，并赋予我们神圣使命。

超主的意志要求彻底湮灭此方现实。§H终末光环§!每吞噬一个星系，便让慈悲的湮灭更近一步。

吾等将见证这必然的终局。

待征服星系数量：[Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]
descriptions.en:
Our Covenant with the §REnd of the Cycle§! grants us untold power, and tasks us with glorious purpose.

The will of our patron demands complete annihilation of this reality. With each system the §HAura of the End§! consumes, the closer merciful oblivion comes to pass.

We shall bear witness to inevitability.

Systems remaining to be conquered: [Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]
